page.layout: One printed page, one text column with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Eandem hanc regionem vel agrum Amnes duo amnes præcipui olim percurrerunt, Agrũ fe-eantes. & percurrunt quoque hodie, quanquam nominibus jam aliis noti, nec eodem ubique retento meatu.

Alter Hunefiu Hunefiu fluvius. quondam dictus in Drentia exoriens, collectis primùm aquis palustribus tenuis, deinde lacum Laræum magnum profundumque ingressus ac permensus, ejusque copiâ auctus, justi jam fluminis instar latus atque altus, Gronenbergiam arcem olim haud incelebrem allapsus, imò penè circumlapsus, relictâ ad rv [?] circiter stadia Groningâ, quæ ei ad occidentem & meridiem erat, in circium deferebatur: mox milliari uno magno infra Groningam flexo cursu rectâ occasum versus se incitabat per Hunesgonios, qui ex eo nomen habuerunt, donec in æstuarium Lavicæ, ut nunc quoque facit, exiret, & communi cum eo ostio se exoneraret inter insulas in Oceanum. Nunc oppi-Hunefide-rivatio.danorum studio oppositis aggeribus, obstructo, quâ urbem prætervehebatur, vetere alveo, relicto ad dextram Gronenbergio solo, ad urbem multos ante annos deriva-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "rv" (the Roman numeral for four, printed small, marked [?]); "Hunefiu" in the text and "Hunefiu fluvius" in the margin, where the last letter could be an s (marked as read). The hyphenated margin note "Agrũ fe-eantes." runs over a line end. Catchword "deriva-" is the last word of the page's text and is not repeated in the paragraph. Signature "A 3" is at the foot. The faint "Digitized by Google" line at the lower right is a digitiser's mark and is left out.
